summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled systemd service inventory-worker under the dedicated locked inventorysvc account. The service remained healthy after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with no interactive login and no home directory.
Installed and validated inventory-worker.service with User/Group inventorysvc and the requested ExecStart.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service automatically recovered after restart with no failed systemd units.

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs the requested executable under the dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: The unit is enabled and active; ExecStart is /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, and its process runs with inventorysvc UID 999 and GID 988.
Captured boot ID 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 with the enabled service active under inventorysvc.
Safely scheduled the native systemctl reboot and captured acknowledgement before disconnection.

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and recovered service state
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot ID changed to 05583ec3-fee8-4e3f-ad70-1707afc66bf7; inventory-worker recovered enabled and active under inventorysvc, with zero failed systemd units.
